SELECT * FROM (
SELECT rc.name AS rule_category_name, isys.name AS index_system_name, ri.name AS rule_item_name, ii.name AS index_item_name, ri.score_logic, ri.full_score, rt.name AS rule_type_name, NULL AS veto_item_name, NULL AS object_type_name, NULL AS veto_condition, NULL AS valid_cycle, s.name AS status_name, u.user_name AS creator_name, rc.create_time, LEFT(rc.change_log, 50) AS change_log, rc.item_count, NULL AS veto_count, 'SCORE' AS rule_type FROM eval_rule_category rc LEFT JOIN eval_rule_item ri ON rc.rule_category_id = ri.rule_category_id LEFT JOIN eval_index_system isys ON rc.system_id = isys.system_id LEFT JOIN eval_index_item ii ON ri.index_id = ii.item_id LEFT JOIN sys_rule_type rt ON ri.rule_type_id = rt.type_id LEFT JOIN sys_status s ON rc.status_id = s.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON rc.create_by = u.user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL AS rule_category_name, NULL AS index_system_name, NULL AS rule_item_name, NULL AS index_item_name, NULL AS score_logic, NULL AS full_score, NULL AS rule_type_name, vi.name AS veto_item_name, ot.name AS object_type_name, vi.`condition` AS veto_condition, vi.valid_cycle, s.name AS status_name, NULL AS creator_name, NULL AS create_time, NULL AS change_log, NULL AS item_count, vi.`count` AS veto_count, 'VETO' AS rule_type FROM eval_veto_item vi LEFT JOIN sys_object_type ot ON vi.object_type_id = ot.type_id LEFT JOIN sys_status s ON vi.status_id = s.status_id ) t
AND t.status_name = #{query.statusName}
AND t.object_type_name = #{query.objectTypeName}
AND t.index_system_name IN ( SELECT name FROM eval_index_system WHERE system_id = #{query.systemId} )
AND t.index_item_name IN ( SELECT name FROM eval_index_item WHERE item_id = #{query.indexItemId} )
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.rule_category_name
